title: Ned Helps a Bug
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Non-fiction, Phase 4, 57-sound stage (dr, fl, fr just added). A true fact: soft, wet mud can trap a small creature, and larger animals sometimes help smaller ones who get stuck.

pages.text: Ned sees a bug in the mud.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling standing at the edge of a muddy patch, spotting a small bug stuck in the mud.

pages.text: The bug can not get up.
pages.illustration: The small bug struggling but unable to lift itself out of the thick mud.

pages.text: Soft mud grips a bug fast.
pages.illustration: Close view of the thick dark mud holding the small bug in place.
Ned the duckling leaning down to help the bug.
Ned the duckling digging into the mud around the bug with his bill.
Ned the duckling lifting the small bug free of the mud.

pages.text: The bug sits on a log.
pages.illustration: The small bug sitting safely on a brown log beside the muddy patch.
The small bug curled up asleep on the brown log.

pages.text: A pal can help a bug that mud grips fast.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling standing proudly beside the log where the rescued bug naps.
